entities.name: Query protein
observations: Sequence length is 188 aa; estimated molecular weight is 20.76 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.94.
The N-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with a cleavable secretion signal; reference annotation places the protein extracellularly.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q27042 pallidipin from Meccus pallidipennis.
Contains a Triabin Pfam domain (PF03973.20) spanning residues 19–164.

entities.name: Q27042 Pallidipin
observations: Reviewed secreted protein from Meccus pallidipennis.

Described as a specific inhibitor of collagen-induced platelet aggregation; proposed mechanism involves scavenging inflammatory eicosanoids such as thromboxane A2, by similarity to related triabin-family proteins.
Annotated to extracellular region and symbiont-mediated perturbation of host defenses.

entities.name: G3CJS0 Dipetalodipin
observations: Reviewed secreted triabin-family homolog with 58.7% identity and 97.9% query coverage.
Binds several eicosanoids and inhibits platelet aggregation, vasoconstriction, angiogenesis, and platelet-assisted NET formation in reported assays.

entities.name: Q18NS7 Triplatin
observations: Reviewed secreted triabin-family homolog with 52.4% identity and full query coverage.
Reported to bind thromboxane/prostaglandin-related eicosanoids and inhibit platelet aggregation and vasoconstriction.
